limits: Each synthetic year is one request/cache/admission transition.
All 1728 configurations are directly executed; worker variants have equivalent schedules, giving 144 distinct modeled cache/chunk behaviors.
The second run independently changes the workload seed; it does not invent new algorithms or produce source patches.
Engine wall time is not the separately measured implementation speedup.

upgradeHypotheses.recommendedAction: Replay max_memo_entries=2048 against the baseline with identical outputs.
upgradeHypotheses.title: Measure the selected bounded memo capacity
validationRequired: Alternating paired real-runtime runs

validationRequired: Digest verification on every returned body

upgradeHypotheses.recommendedAction: Use fewer workers for this synchronous service trace; measure genuinely asynchronous work separately.
